decisions.statement: A folder a change leaves holding nothing is taken off the disk.
A folder still with anything is kept.
A file git does not track counts as something held.
The paths handed in are every path that went, whether git tracks that path or not.
The folders are taken innermost first.
A folder emptied by the child that went is taken alongside that child.
The climb starts at the folder each path that went was in.
The climb stops at the top of the repository.
A folder at the top of the repository is taken where a change leaves that folder empty.
The index is left where it is, however little a change leaves in it.
A folder inside the index is taken as any other folder is.
One rule answers the folders a change would empty and the folders a change did empty.
A folder that will not go is left out of the answer rather than refusing the rest.
A folder taken away is swept innermost first.
A folder still holding a file throws.

definition: a folder a change leaves holding nothing, taken off the disk innermost first
